clue.text: Heartless fool terminating disbursement

indicators.note: heartless asks for the middle letter of the word for fool to be removed

parts.note: a sap is a fool
terminating means coming to an end, ending

explanation.surface: A stupid person brings someone's spending spree to a stop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' removes the middle A from SAP, leaving SP.
explanation.definitionFit: Spending is paying money out, which is what a disbursement is.

clue.text: Scrutinise arches for distortion

indicators.note: distortion twists the letters of arches into a new order

explanation.surface: An inspector is asked to examine some arches for signs of bending.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrutinise is to examine closely, to look over thoroughly.

clue.text: Blackmail is no longer wrong!

parts.note: ex is the prefix for something no longer the case, a former thing
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: An exclamation that blackmail has stopped being a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: To blackmail someone is to obtain money from them by threats.

clue.text: One can but await developments in this area

definitions.text: One can but await developments in this area

parts.words: One can but await developments in this area
parts.note: photographic film is developed in a light-proof room, so waiting for developments there is literal

explanation.surface: A patient person resigned to waiting to see what happens in a region.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographer develops prints in a light-proof room.

clue.text: Directions on producing gas

parts.note: N and E, north and east, are compass directions
taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions on how to produce a gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Neon is a noble gas used in glowing signs.

clue.text: Employees of the county

definitions.meaning: staff are the people employed by a firm
The short form of Staffordshire, an English county in the Midlands

explanation.surface: People who work for the county council.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers form the staff of a firm; Staffordshire, an English Midlands county, is abbreviated in writing.

clue.text: Left following trouble in the plant

indicators.note: following means the next piece comes after the one before

parts.note: to tease is to trouble or pester

explanation.surface: Someone went away after there was a problem in the factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A teasel is a prickly plant whose heads were used to raise the nap on cloth.

clue.text: A story about the queen causing controversy

indicators.note: about means the story's letters surround the royal abbreviation

parts.note: fiction is a made-up story
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A tale about the monarch stirs up a row.
explanation.definitionFit: Friction is disagreement or conflict between people, much like a dispute.

clue.text: Flag to stop on a road

parts.note: to stand is to stop still

explanation.surface: A signal flag telling traffic to halt on a highway.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a banner or flag carried as an emblem.

clue.text: The front, or near it anyway

indicators.note: anyway means in any order, so the letters of or near it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone describing a position at the front or close to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Anterior describes the forward part, as opposed to posterior at the back.

clue.text: Beat into a thin plate

parts.note: to lam is to beat or thrash
into gives in

explanation.surface: Hammering metal flat into a sheet.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamina is a thin layer or sheet, of metal, bone or rock.

clue.text: Creating awful din, true, at the experimental stage

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters of din and true are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: A truthful but noisy racket made during a trial run.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not yet tested is still being experimented on.

clue.text: Copper-not commonly seen as a poison

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
rare means not commonly seen

explanation.surface: A copper compound that is seldom recognised as toxic.
explanation.definitionFit: Curare is a South American plant extract used to tip poisoned arrows.

clue.text: The new resident must be introduced

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of resident

explanation.surface: A newcomer to the area must be presented to the neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inserted has been put in, introduced into a place.

clue.text: Diana's in need of comfort-affection

parts.note: Di is the short form of Diana, plus the possessive S
ease is comfort

explanation.surface: Diana needs some loving comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affection' is used in its old medical sense of an ailment, not fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: An affection in old medical language is a bodily disorder or illness.

clue.text: Stockings and one shoe thrown on the railway

indicators.note: thrown suggests the letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
RY is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A pair of stockings and a single shoe have been tossed onto the tracks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown' shuffles I plus SHOE into HOSIE, then RY follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosiery is the trade term for stockings, socks and tights.

clue.text: Excursion to an ancient city

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A trip out to visit the ruins of an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: A tour is a trip or journey, often for sightseeing.

clue.text: The drops maybe taken by a crock

indicators.note: maybe hints the letters of the drops could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Drips of liquid collected in an earthenware pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A potsherd is a broken piece of pottery, and a crock can mean such a fragment.

clue.text: Designs no amateur models

parts.note: a pro, a professional, is no amateur
models poses, as for an artist

explanation.surface: A professional designer who uses no amateur models.
explanation.definitionFit: To design something can mean to plan or put forward an intention.

clue.text: Lamps on the landing

definitions.meaning: lamps collectively make up the illumination of a room
a bird ... on a branch is landing on it

explanation.surface: Light fittings installed on the top of the stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamps provide illumination; alighting, coming to rest, is a landing.

clue.text: He's a monster, and so regressive!

indicators.note: regressive means going backwards, so the word for and so is read in reverse

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, and so

explanation.surface: A remark that someone is a brute and is therefore backward-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogre is a giant of folklore, a monstrous man-eater.

clue.text: Seem in a mess, having made a bloomer

indicators.note: in a mess means jumbled, so the letters of seem in a are disordered

explanation.surface: Someone looks confused after making a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' is a flowering thing here, not a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesia is a South African garden flower, so it blooms.

clue.text: There's talk of the Irish going on foot

definitions.meaning: the lilting accent of Irish speech
a stout leather shoe worn on the foot

explanation.surface: People are chatting about the Irish walking somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong Irish accent is called this, as is a sturdy perforated shoe.

clue.text: A bad sailor in the main

definitions.text: A bad sailor in the main

parts.words: A bad sailor in the main
parts.note: the main is the high sea, as in the Spanish Main, where a criminal mariner roams; not someone seasick

explanation.surface: Someone who gets seasick on the open ocean, mostly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea robber is a villainous seaman operating on the open ocean.

clue.text: Goddess given a note about a bird

indicators.note: about means the musical note wraps round the bird

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
a hen is a bird

explanation.surface: A goddess is presented with a musical note concerning a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek deity of wisdom, whose emblem is the owl.

clue.text: Check with newsmen after a little drink

indicators.note: after puts the newsmen piece after the drink

parts.note: a sup is a small mouthful of drink
the press are journalists collectively

explanation.surface: Reporters head for a quick drink after checking a story.
explanation.definitionFit: To suppress is to hold back or restrain, as in to check something.

clue.text: A virtue in the garden?

definitions.meaning: careful saving of money, economy, counts as a virtue
sea pink, a cushion-forming plant grown in rock gardens

explanation.surface: Asking whether virtue can be found among the flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Frugality is a virtue; the sea pink, Armeria, is a garden plant sharing the name.

clue.text: Concerning a section of the pastor's congregation

indicators.note: a section of means the letters lie within the word pastor's

explanation.surface: A matter about part of the minister's flock.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase means about or regarding, as does concerning.

clue.text: 8 an American naval officer

definitions.meaning: the answer to 8 down is a flag
a junior commissioned officer in the US Navy

explanation.surface: Cross-reference describing a US navy officer.
explanation.definitionFit: This word is both a flag flown at sea and a junior US Navy rank.

clue.text: Sound point in a 23

indicators.note: in places the compass point inside the a plus 23 down

parts.note: the answer to 23 down is a sea robber
S is south, a compass point

explanation.surface: A navigation point is stated aboard a buccaneer ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspirate a consonant is to pronounce it with breath, sounding an h.

clue.text: Runs many refuse to make

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
ashes are refuse left after burning

explanation.surface: Many people decline to make quick runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Dashes are sprints, quick runs.

clue.text: A writer given leave to go around the minister

indicators.note: to go around means the leave word encloses the minister

parts.note: conge, from French conge, is formal leave or dismissal
Rev is the abbreviation for Reverend, a minister

explanation.surface: An author is granted permission to visit the vicar.
explanation.walkthrough: CONGE is a French word for leave or permission to depart, used in English.
explanation.definitionFit: William Congreve was a Restoration playwright, author of The Way of the World.
